# OzBargain

> > Australia's leading bargain hunting and deal sharing community, featuring electronics, retail discounts, and consumer product offers.

OzBargain is an Australian community-driven platform where users discover and share deals across electronics, computers, TVs, and consumer goods from major retailers like JB Hi-Fi, Deals Direct, and Good Guys. The site aggregates time-sensitive bargains, bulk buy opportunities, and discount promotions across Australia.
